From: Kevin Kappelmann via isabelle-dev <isabelle-dev@proof.cit.tum.de>

Hi all,

86032:7bc3aa955da0 (09.11.2026) adds a rep.isDefinedAt(node_name.theory)
check, but rep is not keyed by theory, so the check fails and, e.g.,
builds lose their loaded files.

Best wishes,

Kevin

Makarius
